row.evidence: Sage Intacct's SSO help covers SAML 2.0 sign-in only, Microsoft's Entra tutorial says to provision users with 'other Sage Intacct user account creation tools or APIs', and no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre, XML API or REST API reference.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). No SCIM endpoint in Sage Intacct's help-centre sitemap, XML developer site or REST API reference; SAML 2.0 SSO only, with users mapped by a Federated SSO user ID (no JIT documented). The sage.com pricing page (June's pricing_page_url, https://www.sage.com/en-us/sage-business-cloud/intacct/pricing/) is blocked by Cloudflare for automated requests, so pricing evidence comes from the help centre: subscriptions are quote-based ('Contact your account manager'), with per-user-type fees. June's '~$12,000/yr minimum' had no first-party source and is dropped. User management is available through the XML Web Services API and the newer REST API (users, user groups, members, roles), but Web Services is itself a subscription, and the help centre says each new subscription adds a monthly fee. June's Aquera note could not be confirmed from an IdP catalogue page and is dropped.

plans.name: Sage Intacct subscription (quote-based)
plans.price_text: Contact your account manager; fees vary by applications subscribed and user type
plans.notes: Public tier table on sage.com could not be loaded (Cloudflare block).

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint; IdPs only federate SAML sign-in, and users must be created in Sage Intacct or via its APIs.

scim.notes: Not offered: no SCIM page in the help-centre sitemap (4,770 pages), the XML API site or the REST API reference.

auth.notes: REST uses OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens; the legacy XML API needs a Web Services sender ID/password plus company user credentials.

capabilities.notes: Deactivation = setting user status to inactive; delete only works for users who never logged in.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a user (only if never logged in) (REST)
List user groups (REST); create/update/delete also documented
List user group members (REST); create/delete also documented
XML Web Services user CRUD and queries

rate_limits.text: Standard level of service allows one concurrent API transaction job per company; a third concurrent request waits 30 seconds then errors.

limitations.text: Users who have logged in cannot be deleted, only made inactive; contact info cannot be changed via the XML API.
Web Services needs a developer license (sender ID) and the Web Services subscription enabled by the company admin.

okta.notes: OIN app 'Sage Intacct' lists SAML and SWA only; no provisioning.

entra.notes: Gallery SSO tutorial; provisioning left to Sage Intacct tools or APIs.

google.notes: Google is listed by Sage as a verified SAML IdP; Google catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: Listed by Sage as a verified SAML IdP; OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).

fallbacks.notes: Each user must exist in Sage Intacct and be enabled for SSO with a Federated SSO user ID; no JIT creation documented.
